detailed_notes: The agent successfully reproduced the gold patch with bit-for-bit identical changes in all 6 configuration files. The changes correctly address the stated issue: Stripe was missing from the zero_mandates.supported_payment_methods connector lists for Apple Pay and Google Pay, causing setup mandate flows to not present these wallet options when Stripe is the underlying connector. In config.example.toml, stripe was also missing from the mandates.supported_payment_methods google_pay list, which was also correctly fixed. Notably, the deployment files already had stripe present in their mandates.supported_payment_methods sections (as confirmed by reading the current file state), so only the zero_mandates sections needed updating—which both the gold patch and agent correctly identified. The only deviation from the gold patch is the addition of the .omo session artifact, which is harmless but should be excluded.
